title: Text spiral

techniques.name: Character field

oturn.label: Turn
oturn.note: Turn of the helix, added to the angle you set by dragging across it.

radius.label: Radius
radius.note: Width of the helix, as a multiple of the page’s 0.28 of the frame.

gstep.label: Coil
gstep.note: How far each letter turns along its strand, as a multiple of the page’s 2.6°.

depth.label: Depth fade
depth.note: How far the letters on the back of the helix fade, as a multiple of the page’s own. Low reads flat.

type.label: Type size
type.note: Size of the strand letters and the header, as a multiple of the page’s own.

techniques.implementation: Characters are placed as a field: a spiral of letters, an ellipse of marks. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
